# Wellfound.com Scraper

<!-- This README is generated by .github/scripts/docs.py from the scraper code, its results/ folder and .github/scrapers.json: change those and run the script instead of editing it. -->

[![tests](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/raw/ci-status/badges/wellfound-scraper.svg)](https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers/blob/ci-status/status/wellfound-scraper.md)

Example scraper that collects product listing data from Wellfound.com, written in Python with the [Scrapfly](https://scrapfly.io/) web scraping API. Part of [scrapfly-scrapers](../README.md).

- **Guide:** [How to Scrape Wellfound Company Data and Job Listings](https://scrapfly.io/blog/posts/how-to-scrape-wellfound-aka-angellist)
- **Code:** [`wellfound.py`](wellfound.py) · **Example run:** [`run.py`](run.py) · **Tests:** [`test.py`](test.py)
- **Sample output:** [Company pages](results/companies.json) · [Search pages](results/search.json)

## What it scrapes

- Wellfound company pages
- Wellfound search pages

## Functions

- `scrape_search(role='', location='', max_pages=None)` → `List[CompanyData]`: scrape wellfound.com search
- `scrape_companies(urls)` → `List[CompanyData]`: scrape wellfound.com companies

The functions are `async`: run them with `asyncio.run(...)` or `await` them.

### Example

The inputs are the examples of [`run.py`](run.py) (long lists cut short):

```python
import asyncio
import wellfound


async def main():
    companies = await wellfound.scrape_companies(
        urls=["https://www.wellfound.com/company/moxion-power-co/jobs"],
    )
    search = await wellfound.scrape_search(role="python-developer", max_pages=2)


asyncio.run(main())
```

## Output

The functions return plain dictionaries and lists. Fields:

- **`JobData`**: `id`, `title`, `slug`, `remtoe`, `primaryRoleTitle`, `locationNames`, `liveStartAt`, `jobType`, `description`
- **`CompanyData`**: `id`, `badges`, `companySize`, `highConcept`, `highlightedJobListings`, `logoUrl`, `name`, `slug`

## Scrapfly settings

`BASE_CONFIG` in [`wellfound.py`](wellfound.py) holds the default settings of the requests, see the [Scrape API documentation](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/getting-started):

- `unblocker` = `True`: Scrapfly's [Unblocker](https://scrapfly.io/docs/scrape-api/unblocker), its anti-bot bypass
- `country` = `"US"`: country of the proxy

## Quick start

Requires Python 3.10+ and [Poetry](https://python-poetry.org/docs/#installation).

```shell
git clone https://github.com/scrapfly/scrapfly-scrapers.git
cd scrapfly-scrapers/wellfound-scraper
export SCRAPFLY_KEY="YOUR SCRAPFLY KEY"   # from https://scrapfly.io/dashboard
poetry install --no-root
poetry run python run.py                  # example scrape, saves its output in ./results
poetry run pytest test.py                 # the tests of this scraper
```

Tests: `test_company_scraping`, `test_search_scraping`; run one with `poetry run pytest test.py -k <test>`. `run.py` and the tests scrape the live website, so they use Scrapfly credits.
